campaign.title: M2 UNBAL prescribed-centre Kloosterman-fraction dispersion source map

resource_policy.literature_policy: Use primary sources only. Record the exact theorem number, version, phase, supports, coprimality, coefficient norms, fixed-factor hypotheses, absolute-value placement, uniformity, and parameter ranges. Structural resemblance is not applicability. The withdrawn arXiv:2601.00292 is a negative bibliographic control and may not be used as a theorem.

frozen_target.question: Can the exact flat-smooth prescribed-centre M2 UNBAL wave be mapped, without changing its real centre, chi_4 placement, moving q_L and W profiles, pointwise absolute-value direction, or endpoint ownership, to the Bettin-Chandee or Wright partially-fixed-modulus Kloosterman-fraction machinery and thereby prove the X^(1/4+epsilon) target; if not, what is the first exact inverse-phase, congruence, coefficient, range, averaging, endpoint, or capacity mismatch?
frozen_target.reference_formula: R_(D,L)(X)=sum_(r odd) chi_4(r)W(X/(rD)) sum_k q_L(4Xk/r^2)k^(-1)e(Xk/r)=sum_s sum_(r|s,r odd)chi_4(r)W(X/(rD))Q_L(r(X-s)/(4X)), with r asymp X/D, k asymp XL/D^2, |s-X| effectively at most D/L, Q_L(y)=int q_L(h)h^(-1)e(hy)dh, and target |R_(D,L)(X)|<<X^(1/4+epsilon).
quantities: D=X^delta, L=X^ell, R=X/D, K=XL/D^2, Delta=D/L, and K/R=L/D=Delta^(-1)
absolute product capacity Delta X^epsilon and accepted scalar envelope X^epsilon min(Delta,sqrt(XL/D)+sqrt(X/(LD)))
Bettin-Chandee phase e(vartheta a mbar/n) with independent dyadic coefficient sequences and (m,n)=1
Wright phase e(theta a mbar/(nR_0)) with a fixed denominator factor R_0, independent dyadic coefficient sequences, and (m,nR_0)=1
the project phase e(Xk/r) is an ordinary short additive fraction; any inverse reindexing, completion, Mellin separation, or physical congruence must be derived and priced
X is a real fixed centre, while r divides the product variable s in the physical form
flat-smooth strict-UNBAL principal owner only; every nonflat, hard, sharp, clipped, starred, arithmetic-owner, stationary-entry, transition, and remainder package stays separate

completion_criteria: Build an exact source card for Bettin-Chandee Theorem 1 and Wright v2 Theorem 2.1, and include only directly relevant corollaries whose full hypotheses are checked.
Derive a literal variable dictionary, or prove that none exists, for both the reciprocal Fourier form and the prescribed-centre divisor form.

Audit the direct m=1 specialization, the substitution k to modular inverse, completion of the K-short interval modulo r, the coupled profile q_L(4Xk/r^2), and every resulting coefficient norm or Fourier mass.
Audit real X versus integral additive frequency, the self-modulus relation r|s, fixed residue and coprimality, pointwise fixed-centre versus modulus averages, and absolute-value placement.
Price every formally legal source specialization throughout the full strict-UNBAL exponent polytope and compare it with Delta and X^(1/4).
Keep chi_4 before every modulus or positive norm and preserve all literal smooth profiles and source/project endpoint owners.
Close under exactly one label: applicable_positive_margin, exact_missing_hypothesis, or source_level_no_go.
Make no complete-UNBAL, BAL, TOP, M9-M2, M1, endpoint, M9, quarter, or global-exponent promotion without the corresponding graph dependencies.

tasks.target: Extract and audit the exact primary-source statements that could conceivably control the literal wave, centered on Bettin-Chandee Theorem 1 and Wright v2 Theorem 2.1, including every hypothesis and the strongest legally relevant specialization.
required_output: Exact theorem cards with version, theorem number, phase, support, coefficient norms, coprimality, fixed-factor and range hypotheses, and absolute-value placement.
A table of every directly legal or illegal specialization to the project scales.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Starting from both exact representations of R_(D,L), construct the strongest owner-preserving Kloosterman-fraction or dispersion map available, or isolate its first exact failure and price all formally legal degeneracies and completion costs.
required_output: Exact dictionaries for direct m=1, inverse reindexing/completion, and physical congruence routes.
A target estimate, strict smaller survivor, or first exact mismatch with the surviving power of X.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

tasks.target: Independently decide from the supplied wave and theorem statements whether an exact coefficient-independent inverse-phase or fixed-residue dispersion interface exists and is target-capable; identify the first unproved step if not.
excluded_context: all Round-107 through Round-135 nonblind artifacts
required_output: A direct proof or no-go for the inverse/congruence dictionary, including coefficient and capacity controls.
A target estimate, strict smaller survivor, or exact source-interface obstruction.
Write only the assigned report and make no graph or shared-state edit.

review_seams.requirement: The exact current primary-source theorem and all hypotheses are recorded; withdrawn or merely analogous results are excluded.
Ordinary k/r and modular inverse mbar/n are not identified without an exact invertible variable map and coefficient ledger.
Coprimality, fixed factor, fixed residue, real-centre, and self-modulus divisibility conditions match literally.
Moving profiles remain legal independent coefficients or their separation cost and norm inflation are explicit.
Every theorem bound and completion loss is normalized back to R_(D,L) and tested uniformly on the full strict-UNBAL polytope.
Only the flat-smooth prescribed-centre principal owner may change state; endpoint and downstream claims require separate proofs.

closing_assessment.main_result: Every real centre admits an exact integral-frequency repair, the direct and square inverse dictionaries are legal, the diagonal projective norm is sharp, smooth-first completion returns exactly Delta, inverse-first completion is a rough joint Kloosterman matrix, Wright dispersion mismatches the literal scalar, and the fixed-determinant map is non-saving. The named standard-source route is parked, but a new chi_4-signed joint theorem remains possible.
